fields.name: BeamParticleSystem
fields.doc: Optional world particle system emitted between the player and locked target while channeling.

fields.name: BeamNativeLength
fields.doc: Authored forward length of the beam particle system, used to scale it to the target distance.

fields.name: BeamNativeDurationSeconds
fields.doc: Authored travel duration corresponding to BeamNativeLength. Used to stop fixed-size particles at the target.

fields.name: ScaleBeamToTarget
fields.doc: Whether to scale the whole particle system to the target distance. Disable for fixed-size traveling particles.

fields.name: BeamFromTarget
fields.doc: Whether particles travel from the locked NPC target toward the player's held item instead of toward the NPC.

fields.name: HomingProjectileEnabled
fields.doc: Use harmless model-particle carrier entities that retarget the held-item anchor each tick.

fields.name: HomingProjectileModelId
fields.doc: Model asset whose attached particles render each capture mote.

fields.name: HomingProjectileSpawnIntervalSeconds
fields.doc: Seconds between independently homing capture motes.

fields.name: HomingProjectileSpeed
fields.doc: Capture mote travel speed in blocks per second.

fields.name: HomingProjectileTurnRateDegreesPerSecond
fields.doc: Optional turn limit. Zero directly retargets the live held-item anchor.

fields.name: HomingProjectileArrivalRadius
fields.doc: Distance from the held-item anchor at which a mote is removed.

fields.name: HomingProjectileLifetimeSeconds
fields.doc: Hard lifetime for each non-serialized capture mote.

fields.name: HomingProjectileMaxConcurrent
fields.doc: Maximum active homing motes owned by one capture session.

fields.name: CaptureBurstParticleSystem
fields.doc: Optional one-shot world particle system emitted at the target after capture succeeds.

fields.name: ChannelDurationSeconds
fields.doc: Maximum lifetime of the server-tracked channel visuals.

fields.name: Slot
fields.doc: Fixed hotswap slot: Q, E, or R.

fields.name: LookTargetDistance
fields.doc: Optional positive distance along the source look direction used instead of Target or TargetSlot. This supports transformed players and other actors without an NPC marked-target role.

fields.name: Source
fields.doc: Entity whose configured anchor supplies the one-time launch position.

fields.name: Target
fields.doc: Entity whose live anchor is recomputed every server tick.
